description: This file defines a wizard interface for selecting and opening account chart views in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form layout, default values, and window actions.

classes.name: wizard_account_chart
classes.description: Wizard class for selecting account charts and opening related views.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Sets default fiscal year in the form based on the current fiscal year.

methods.name: _account_chart_open_window
methods.description: Prepares and returns the window action to display the account chart, including context and dynamic naming.
